svg.title: Madar Al Bayan: from a question to published evidence or a human reply
svg.desc: Nine supported languages lead to Astra question understanding, retrieval through nine approved references, a second Astra context check and literal-source validation. Relevant evidence is ranked and attributed. If evidence is unavailable or review is needed, the visitor can submit a numbered enquiry to the supervisor and receive a human-written email reply. Specialist consultation is manual. Dedicated assignment and SMS delivery are planned.
svg.text: MADAR AL BAYAN / THE COMPLETE QUESTION JOURNEY
Published evidence when available. Human follow-up when needed.
Ask in any of nine supported languages
The question determines the answer language; the interface opens in English.
Identify the intent, topic, requested action, conditions and negation.
Prepare search expressions in the same language; preserve the original question.
Retrieve from the approved reference network
Search applicable text collections; fetch records or use saved official editions.
Merge and deduplicate candidates; retain text, title, language, source ID and reference.
Astra checks the meaning of each passage
Compare available passages with the unchanged original question.
Check the same topic, conditions and requested details.
Keep relevant, complementary evidence from multiple publishers; reject word-only matches.
Known record · correct language · verbatim quotation
Show the most relevant passage first.
Add other publishers when their passages
answer the same topic or a requested part.
Up to five results · scores stay private.
Future references in a separate section.
Write an answer, or seek specialist
Human reply in the questioner's language.
Logical free-question journey. Exact topics and verse IDs can use a direct lookup.
Language and item availability vary by reference. Audio and catalogs are not answer passages.
